description: Evaluate a Content-Security-Policy string the way CSP Evaluator does, before you ship it: parses directives, catches typos, unquoted keywords and deprecated directives, then checks script execution (unsafe-inline without nonce/hash, unsafe-eval, wildcards, http:/https:/data: sources, 40+ known allowlist-bypass hosts with JSONP / AngularJS / user content), object-src, base-uri, frame-ancestors, form-action, reporting and Trusted Types. Returns findings with severity and fixes, a 0-100 score and A-F grade, and a strict nonce-based policy template. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/csp-evaluate

meta.description: Policy is delivered in a <meta> tag (frame-ancestors, report-uri and sandbox are then ignored by browsers)

policy.description: The policy value (without the header name)
